subject: Committed repair baseline (reports/defect/repair/classifications.parquet)
method: scripts.defect_accuracy per label set; missing predictions count as wrong; no fitting on any label set
reading: Baseline holds 81.3-87.0% across Rahul, adjudicated gold v2, Aryan, Kaushal and Ram label sets, above the 74.0% always-other_unclear reference (222/300 on gold v2). Abhishek is a disclosed outlier at 65.4%, consistent with his low kappa (0.23 vs Rahul); his labels are retained, not excluded.
limits: All sets share the same opened 300-record sample; this is robustness across labelers, not a fresh holdout.
Blinding unconfirmed. Candidate improvement remains rejected (79.3% vs 82.0% on gold v2); no improvement is claimed.
Strong (9-10) evidence still requires the preregistered round-5 blinded validation on a new sample.
